# uuBright

> uuBright is an independent engineering studio. This file is a navigation aid for readers and AI tools; linked public pages are the authoritative sources.

## Company and products

- [uuBright](https://uubright.com/): Company overview, AI infrastructure, usage systems, technical education, and contact information.
- [MyMedia Photos](https://uubright.com/mymedia/): Local-first photo organizer for macOS, by uuBright. Currently in testing; a free first public release is planned, with no public download yet.
- [MyMedia Photos privacy policy](https://uubright.com/mymedia/privacy/): Local processing, Google Drive permissions, credentials, retention, external services, and contact.
- [uuRoute](https://uuroute.ai/): Routing, observability, and governance for production AI.
- [Meterry](https://meterry.com/): Usage metering, pricing controls, and billing evidence.
- [SciMigo](https://scimigo.com/): Technical education and interactive learning.

## MyMedia Photos facts

- Requires macOS 14 or later; Apple Silicon is recommended. ONNX-backed visual search, face embeddings and object erase are unavailable on Intel Macs; broader Intel acceptance testing is pending.
- Test builds include collections, trips and events, and separate read-only Apple Photos browsing.
- Guided iPhone USB imports use Apple Image Capture. Verified local folder copies are not encrypted and never delete phone assets.
- Optional experimental cloud backup requires Google sign-in and a recovery phrase. File contents and metadata are encrypted on the Mac before incremental upload; the server still sees account identity, ciphertext sizes and timing. Keep another copy. Cloud storage allowances and pricing have not been announced.
- Signed test builds are available by email request. The Apple Silicon test build is notarized; broader public-release acceptance remains pending.

- Indexes local photo folders in place. Local OCR, content analysis, and face recognition run on the user's Mac. Face recognition and object erase use additional local models.
- Reviews exact duplicates, previews organize operations with undo, and saves edits as separate files.
- Optional Google Drive connection is in testing: browser sign-in, folder browsing, and a user-selected original copied locally. Drive for desktop is not required.
- Google Drive readonly permission is account-wide. Folder selection restricts app processing, not Google's access grant. MyMedia's Drive integration does not modify cloud files.
- Google Drive access is distinct from Google Photos, which are not provided by this integration.
- Optional geocoding, cloud portrait generation, S3 folder copies (without MyMedia client-side encryption or restore), and external AI agents can send selected data outside the Mac as described in the privacy policy. Do not describe the app as wholly offline or promise that data can never leave the device.
- Support and privacy contact: david.shao@uubright.com. Company contact: sales@uubright.com.

- Default daily update check: no app-generated identifier; api.scimigo.com with a uubright.com static fallback. Disable in About. Aggregate requests may inform usage counts.
- Optional Apple Messages attachment browsing requires macOS Full Disk Access but does not read conversation databases or upload attachments.
